name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: Supplier details now separate Transactions from Purchase Orders and GRNs
Purchase order and GRN totals no longer affect supplier payable balances
Orders tab tracks PO/GRN status, converted bills, cancelled documents, and unbilled totals
Unbilled order value is shown under You Will Pay on supplier details
Purchase returns are clearly labelled with their return reason in the supplier ledger
